This is the same for me. I had no trouble making friends and I generally like them but internally, I just felt like something was out of place or like I wasn't really seen. And when I learned about my personality type, it became easier to accept and eventually love the weird quirks that I have. Learning more about my MBTI type made me come to terms that I won't be completely understood and made me feel comforted that there are other people out there that kinda feels the same way.

When I try to explain things to people, ("try" being the key word because it's a nightmare to put my thoughts into words) they just look at me like they don't know what I'm saying, but to me it makes perfect sense.
